title: MLP and backpropagation

paper.title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement MLP and backpropagation: derive NumPy cross-entropy gradients for XOR and a three-arm spiral extension. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use xor; required output: [N,2] -> [N,C] logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). NumPy analytic gradients agree with central differences; three-arm spirals are an optional generated extension. Required ablation: Remove the hidden nonlinearity; compare finite-difference gradient errors.
